notes: The session's shared web-search allowance ran out after seven searches (the five legislative candidates), so the rest was read directly, one page at a time, with the kit's honest User-Agent (states/net.py) and each site's robots.txt obeyed: the candidates' filed campaign sites, each county's, city's and school district's own site, and Wikipedia. The Minnesota DFL's list of endorsed candidates was read with the fetch tool.

No new campaign website was found. Ten candidates in this slice already have one filed with the Secretary of State (Hanson, Theis, Nadeau, Clardy, Greene, Hellier, Specht, Carly Anderson, Davis, Wilcox); those were read, not listed again. www.judgemattwilcox.com answered 404, and www.sanderiaforsspschools.com gave a plain reader only its title.

Not read: the Minnesota Judicial Branch's site and mn.gov (bot checks reported by other parts; not asked), so the two judges have no findings; Jackson County's site (its robots.txt asks scripts to stay out). The official pages of Mahnomen County, Ham Lake, Albert Lea, Victoria, Detroit Lakes and South St. Paul do not list Swiers, Willman, Caucutt, Almquist, Grzybowski or Davis among today's members, so no office is recorded for them. Nothing was found for Moore, Kimlinger or Aleathea Anderson.

Danny Nadeau's own site shows no party endorsement for 2026 in the parts read, and without search no Republican party page naming him or Geri Theis was found; Theis's endorsement is recorded only in her own words on her own site.
